statement: There is a QMA-complete promise problem whose Hamiltonians are Hin = X e=LR Jehs LR on finite, nonwrapping subgraphs of the square lattice, with no one-qubit terms. The signed weights Je are rational. The number of vertices and edges, the lattice extent, the weight magnitudes, and the threshold magnitudes are bounded by fixed polynomials in the source size n ≥ 2. The rational thresholds as < bs have separation δs = bs − as ≥ 1/ poly(n).
